title: fix(plugin-view,types): an object-view table relays the grid keys ObjectGrid honours, and the slot stops typing the rest (objectui#10976)
body:
Fixes #10976
Clause-②: yes

## What this does

`ObjectViewSchema.table` typed every `ObjectGridSchema` member except `type` and `objectName` (60 keys at `9b85600b0`), and the grid node `ObjectView` builds for its grid view (the `gridSchema` memo, route 2: the registered renderer with no `renderListView`) copied 13 of them. So `table: { editable: true }` type-checked, passed `safeValidateSchema`, and did nothing. Triage `5872710926` ruled: relay what the grid honours, narrow the rest, key by key.

- **Relay (`@object-ui/plugin-view`).** `OBJECT_VIEW_TABLE_RELAY_KEYS`, one list beside the grid-node build, copied only when the author wrote the key (no default injected). The card's 14 (`editable`, `singleClickEdit`, `frozenColumns`, `rowHeight`, `resizable`, `searchableFields`, `conditionalFormatting`, `rowActions`, `bulkActions`, `exportOptions`, `grouping`, `rowColor`, `showSearch`, `showPagination`) plus five more measured the same way (`aggregations`, `bulkActionDefs`, `reorderableColumns`, `showColumnTypeIcons`, `label`). Where the active named view declares the same member (the objectui#10885 rungs), the named view still wins and `table` is the fallback, the precedence `pagination` / `selection` / `filter` / `sort` already had. The relay reaches `ObjectGrid` through the same node, no side channel.
- **Narrow (`@object-ui/types`, Clause-② yes).** `ObjectGridSlotKey` now holds the 12 keys the build reads by name, the 19 relayed keys, and the three `never`-typed tombstones `ObjectGridSchema` declares (`body`, `children`, `defaultSort`, kept so their named refusal stays on this face). 26 keys are withheld, each measured (table below). The zod twin keeps deriving from `ObjectGridSchema` and refuses each withheld key BY NAME inside the slot (`retirementTombstone`), so both faces refuse the same keys. A tombstone and not an `.omit()`, because `BaseSchema` is `.passthrough()` and an omitted key would be kept unexamined.
- **Docblock.** The "59 keys" count is replaced by a pointer at the pin that re-derives it (`object-view-slot-key-lists.test.ts`), per AGENTS.md #9 (point at the instrument, never write its answer). The same stale count in the adjacent `ObjectFormSlotKey` docblock ("64 keys"; the checker reads 65) gets the same treatment, and the objectui#5155 removal condition is restated true for both: the form list is still removable when the index signature goes, the table list becomes an `Omit` of identity plus withheld keys and its pin stays.

## Premise, measured on `origin/main` `9b85600b0`

- `ObjectGridSlotKey`: 60 members (docblock said 59). `ObjectView.tsx` reads 13 off `table` (every `schema.table?.KEY`, no spread): the card's list, confirmed.
- Each of the card's 14 relay keys has a non-comment `schema.KEY` read in `ObjectGrid.tsx` (e.g. `inlineEditable = (schema.editable ?? false) && …`, `schema.frozenColumns ?? 1`, `schema.singleClickEdit ?? true`). `emptyState` and `showFilters`: zero reads in all of `packages/plugin-grid/src` (control word `showSearch` hits in the same query).
- ⚠️ One of the 13 "read" keys is not honoured: `description` is copied onto the grid node and `ObjectGrid` has zero `description` reads. It is withheld here and the dead copy dropped (same defect class, bounded in-place fix; named here as the role file asks).
- Producers of an `object-view` `table` (docs, examples, README, app-shell builders, tests), census of top-level keys inside every `table: {…}` block in `content/`, `docs/`, `skills/`, `examples/` and package READMEs: only `columns`, `pageSize`, `pagination`, `sort`, `filter`; app-shell's Studio writes `table: { fields }`. No producer writes a withheld key. Positive control: the census finds the two schema-catalog JSON fixtures and the three doc files it should.

## Per-key disposition (the withheld 26)

| Reason | Keys |
| --- | --- |
| `ObjectGrid` has no read | `emptyState`, `showFilters`, `description`, `keyboardNavigation`, `rowSpecActions`, `bulkSpecActions`, `name`, `placeholder` |
| owned by the view | `data`, `staticData`, `bind` (record source: the view lists its own `objectName`), `navigation`, `onNavigate` (the view hands the grid its own `onRowClick`, which the grid obeys first), `id` (identity, like `type` / `objectName`) |
| node-level `BaseSchema` keys | `style`, `testId`, `ariaLabel`, `hidden`, `hiddenOn`, `visible`, `visibleOn`, `visibleWhen`, `disabled`, `disabledOn` (the view renders `ObjectGrid` as a component, not through `SchemaRenderer`, so nothing applies them) |
| legacy alias of a relayed key | `batchActions` (write `bulkActions`), `resizableColumns` (write `resizable`) |

The aliases are withheld rather than relayed: neither ever worked on this slot, so no document depends on them, and relaying would open a second spelling on a new path.

## Pins

- `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-view-slot-key-lists.test.ts`: slot == source members minus identity minus `TABLE_WITHHELD_BY_REASON` (checker-derived); the zod twin's nested `table` refuses EXACTLY the withheld set plus the inherited tombstones (`operators`, the zod-only misspelling tombstone of objectui#9739, included); every withheld key fails `safeParse` at `table.KEY` with `invalid_type` and guidance naming objectui#10976; lit controls.
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-view-table-slot-10976.test.ts`: `@ts-expect-error` per withheld reason (an unused directive fails `type-check`), lit control.
- `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.tableSlotRelay-10976.test.tsx`: compile-time classification (every slot key is read by name, relayed, or a tombstone; none twice; `Required` samples for every relay key), every relayed and by-name key arriving on the node, named-view precedence with `table` fallback, nothing invented, withheld keys not arriving.
- `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.tableEditable-10976.test.tsx`: the REAL `ObjectGrid` opens an in-cell editor for `table.editable`, and the object's grant still wins.
- `ObjectView.routeTwoNamedGridMembers-10885.test.tsx`: its CONTROL pinned the node's `table` NOT arriving for eight members; it now pins them arriving (this card's change of fact).
- `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`: `table` left the `KnownDrift` row of `objectql.zod.ts#ObjectViewSchema` (the slot no longer types `onNavigate`, the callable the nested mirror refused), header figure 49 / 88 to 49 / 87 with its history sentence.

- Union at final head `7488eeaa2`: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-view/ packages/types/ examples/schema-catalog/test/safe-validate-corpus-6318.test.ts examples/schema-catalog/test/component-fixture-declared-keys.test.ts` read `Test Files 344 passed (344)`, `Tests 7117 passed (7117)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-view type-check` green after building the plugin-view dependency closure (`turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/plugin-view^...`, 15 tasks). `tsc --listFilesOnly` shows the new test files in both test programs, and plugin-view reading `packages/types/dist/objectql.d.ts`. Types sources did not change after that run; the one plugin-view test file that changed after it was re-type-checked green on the committed bytes.
- Reverse verification (cross-package type): planted `'emptyState'` into `OBJECT_VIEW_TABLE_RELAY_KEYS` through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed); `plugin-view` `tsc --noEmit` answered `error TS2322: Type '"emptyState"' is not assignable to type 'ObjectGridSlotKey'`; restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The first attempt used an anchor its own replacement contained; the tool refused it (count 1 to 1) and restored, so that attempt measured nothing.
- Ablation (relay): deleted the copy loop in `authoredTableRelay`; the three relay files went red in exactly four tests (THE FIX, named-view fallback, route-two CONTROL, real-grid editor) with 17 passing (lit controls, grant, by-name, withheld); restored and verified.
- Ablation (zod refusal): deleted `.extend(OBJECT_VIEW_TABLE_WITHHELD)`; the slot pin went red in 27 tests (set equality plus 26 per-key refusals); restored and verified.
- ESLint on the 9 changed source and test files (`--no-inline-config --format json`): 9 files, 0 errors; the warnings are the files' existing `no-explicit-any` / `react-refresh` population plus one `react-refresh/only-export-components` on the new exported list, the rule the file's other exported lists already carry. The new test files lint clean.
- Gates green at `7488eeaa2`: `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 13 paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:readme-exports`, `check:doc-snippets`, `check:doc-examples`, reason: each needs dist for packages outside this change's closure and exited on that prerequisite. The docs change adds no code fence; the only fenced `table` blocks in the touched docs use `columns` / `pageSize` / `pagination` / `sort` / `filter`, all still declared.

## Changeset

`.changeset/10976-table-slot-relay.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-view` patch, `@object-ui/types` minor (a narrowing breaks a writer of a withheld key; the body says which keys and for whom; objectui's major tracks `@objectstack`'s).

## Acceptance notes (not filed)

- `ObjectGridSchema` itself declares members `ObjectGrid` never reads, on the `object-grid` node directly: `emptyState`, `showFilters`, `description`, `keyboardNavigation`, `rowSpecActions`, `bulkSpecActions`, `name`, `placeholder`. The schema reference's `ObjectGridSchema` example authors `showFilters` and `description`. Out of scope here (this card owns the `object-view` slot); reported to the seat.
- A host that supplies `renderListView` composes its own `list-view` node and takes only `columns`, `fields`, `filter` and `sort` from `table`, as before; `pageSize`, `pagination`, `selection` and the relayed keys do not reach that path. No in-repo host authors those on `table`.
